system.description:
Mental Conditioning. +1 Talent Die when resisting negative effects caused by pain. You take half damage from attacks that deal Soul damage.

Traumatised (Flaw). Lose 1 Skill Die on Heart Checks with 'normal' people.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.91

system.abilityDescription: +1 Talent Die when resisting negative effects caused by pain. You take half damage from attacks that deal Soul damage.

when.label: Resisting a negative effect caused by pain

automation.note: Only Soul damage from attacks is halved. The resistance halves all Soul damage, so undo it for non-attack sources (e.g. Painful Memories).
